recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, duo-tone composition featuring a male musician with a guitar overlaid on a dark landscape. The aesthetic utilizes a primary deep blue palette with a horizontal red-tinted band at the bottom, topped with bold, yellow slab-serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Primary blue and gold color contrast
Horizontal banding separating main image from footer text
Large-scale display type against dark background
coreInvariants: High-contrast monochrome treatment of the portrait
Heavy slab-serif font with tight leading
Horizontal red gradient band at the base

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Musician positioned on the left third, medium shot, slightly angled toward the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright yellow display text in the upper right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the portrait, moves to the large name text, then down through the landscape to the footer text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep blue shadows and dark landscape provide significant breathing room for the yellow text.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the yellow text and dark blue background; low saturation in the photographic elements.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different scales and weights.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serifs and geometric structure.
Provides the necessary horizontal weight and slab terminals.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a high-contrast duo-tone image in deep navy blue. On the left, a man with a mustache sings into a microphone while holding a guitar. The background is a dark, silhouetted landscape of hills. At the bottom, add a horizontal band with a dark red gradient.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, extended slab-serif text in golden yellow. Place the primary name in the top right corner with tight leading. Place the secondary title centered in the red band at the bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the primary color deep navy blue?
Is the text a bold, yellow slab-serif?
Is there a red band at the bottom?
Is the portrait high-contrast and integrated with the landscape?

adjustableVariables: Width of the red bottom band

mustAchieve: Strong legibility of yellow text on dark blue

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the yellow text is not vibrating against the blue.
Check that the red band does not overwhelm the composition.
Verify the slab serifs are thick and blocky.
Confirm the portrait has a grainy, vintage texture.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast blue-tinted portrait with a dark landscape overlay, anchored by bold yellow slab-serif typography and a red horizontal footer.
